scope: Owned same-file injected metadata/extent reader using the shared observation host. No live provider, physical handle, public operation or durable reconnect admission.
ownership: Preparation pins code and builds finite mappings/job/events without creating a child. The adapter retains the prepared session before capture start and launch. Immediately store a successful CreateProcessW process/thread handle before identity lookup/allocation. A verified no-launch attempt may fail without claiming exit. Post-spawn exceptions retain the exact owned reader and outstanding capture until an actual exit observation. No replacement, cancellation acknowledgement or effect certainty follows from startup failure.
transport: Exactly five inherited handles: read-only input, writable output, cancellation, admission and dispatch gate. No storage or ambient stdio handles. Code/request/host/capture/observer/worker/attempt/native process identities bind one bounded digest-checked publication. Compile-time profile selection preserves the separate namespace protocol and limits.
input: Bound selected subject keys/kinds/original UTF-16 labels and finite metadata policy to generated API reply fixtures. Neither numbers nor serialized handles select physical resources. Native/mixed API pointers are refused before admission. The compiled fixture factory alone is qualified; wrappers are not authenticated by pointer comparison.
validation: The parent checks exact envelope/process bindings and reconstructs the canonical private frame from bounded returned-byte receipts and original subject/policy selection. Replay is pure receipt decoding through an internal synthetic port, not a native query or proof of provenance/omitted calls. Claims, statuses, metadata/ranges/conflicts, limits and names must agree with reconstructed content. Known byte digests must match. An exception receipt remains conservative unknown evidence.
graph: Only owned-session context can supply the adapter's process/request/code binding. Result publication and process retirement remain separate; pending/exception/cancelled/partial frames retain outstanding readers until exact exit. Superseded capture results cannot replace current observations. Preserve prior complete data as explicitly stale without recursively growing a partial cache.
required_checks: Actual x64/x86 owned reader launch, no inherited storage handles, code/process/input/reply identity and SDK/import closure.
Healthy/conflicting/denied/pending/exception metadata; finite waits, late replies, cancellation, held publication and reader retirement.
Before-launch and after-spawn failures retain distinct state; post-spawn allocation failure retains ownership; no replacement before actual exit, followed by a newly eligible capture.
Malformed envelope/frame/receipt/status/policy/authority refused; superseded replies and independent peer source preserved.
Existing namespace worker/graph/lifecycle and standalone metadata campaigns remain passing.
